Title: What 9 Weeks of Writing on Substack Taught Me

In today's fast-paced digital landscape, building an audience can feel overwhelming. The truth? It's not about going viral — it's about showing up.

When I started this newsletter 9 weeks ago, I had no idea what I was doing. Now I have 47 subscribers and I've made $312 from paid readers. Let's delve into the lessons that helped me unlock this growth.

1. Consistency is a game-changer. Publishing every week serves as the foundation of trust with readers.

2. Notes are more than just a feature — they're an ecosystem. By leveraging Notes, I was able to foster genuine connections.

3. Experts agree that authenticity matters. Studies show readers can tell when you're faking it.

Ultimately, this journey has been nothing short of transformative. It's a testament to the power of showing up, and I'm excited to see where this intricate, rewarding path leads next.

What will you build?
